before.title: continual 與 continuous
before.content: 兩者皆可指「連續地」；continual 主要指持續一段長時間、曾多次停止後重新開始；continuous 指過程不中斷、持續進行。

after.content: 兩者皆為形容詞；continual 常指反覆發生的、頻繁的，continuous 常指連續不斷的。兩者部分語境可重疊；對應副詞為 continually、continuously。

patches.reason: 將形容詞解釋為「連續地」混淆詞性；保留用法重疊，不將區分寫成絕對規則。

content.reason: 將形容詞解釋為「連續地」混淆詞性；保留用法重疊，不將區分寫成絕對規則。

sources.excerpt: Continual describes an activity that occurs repeatedly, but with intermittent breaks. Continuous describes something that occurs without a break in time or in space.
sources.support: L33 separately identifies continually and continuously as adverbs; L57 classifies the topic under Adjectives. The adjective/adverb distinction and usual recurring/uninterrupted distinction are directly supported. The patch preserves rather than denies potential usage overlap.
